The candidate set \(\{-19,-18,\dots,18,19\}\) contains \(39\) integers.

Now impose the two-digit condition on \(q=4r^2\):
\[
4r^2 \le 99 \implies r^2 \le 24.75 \implies |r| \le 4.
\]
Thus \(r\in\{-4,-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3,4\}\), giving \(9\) possible values of \(r\). Each gives a distinct pair \((p,q)=(-5r,4r^2)\).

\[
\boxed{9}
\]
